meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 它以问答方式了解你的工作，和你一起设计并安装一套自定义笔记规则（含观察类型与标签），可选设置提醒，然后验证新规则生效。安装后，新笔记会按该规则生成。
howto.when: 当你想定制 claude-mem 的记忆方式，比如创建或改变模式、添加观察类型或标签、为某些记忆设置提醒等时触发，即使你没用“模式”一词。

say.text: 我是律师，想记录判例规则和导师提到的考点。
say.note: 启动访谈，它会围绕律师工作提出候选项。

say.text: 我为设计团队工作，帮我设置一个模式，记下设计决定和客户偏好。
给所有标记为“故障”的记录加上 Telegram 通知。
say.note: 配置在匹配到该标签时发送提醒。

howto.what_en: It interviews you, then designs, installs, and verifies a custom mode with custom note types and tags, optionally adds Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and confirms the new mode is active. Future notes follow your rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers—create or change a mode, add observation types/tags, or send Telegram alerts for certain memories—even without the word mode.

say_en.text: I'm a law student; I want to note case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: Starts an interview for a law-oriented mode.

say_en.text: Help me set up a mode for design decisions and client preferences.
say_en.note: Proposes and installs after your approval.

say_en.text: Notify me via Telegram whenever the tag 'incident' is used.
say_en.note: Adds Telegram triggers for that concept.
